summary: Created a 6-phase implementation plan for the lean detach-then-await contradiction. The plan keeps lean's detachment plus build guard and replaces only the wait step with bounded-build-waiter.md's single-Bash-call idiom, starting at the root cause (long-builds.md's self-contradictory Obligation-1/Completion-discipline sections) before propagating to the two lean implementation agents, the two research agents, rules/lean4.md and skill-lake-repair. Acceptance is mechanical: discharge lint-agent-contracts.sh Check K's written removal condition so both lean agents are evaluated and PASS on merit, plus a replayed lake-build-guard.sh invocation under the new idiom. file_scope was confirmed and SET at plan time to ten paths (lake-build-guard.sh deliberately excluded; three core files added).

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: empirical idiom probe, long-builds.md root-cause rewrite, implementation-agent propagation, remaining lean contract sites, lint-exclusion discharge with its regression test retargeted, then redeploy plus successor task and wrap-up.
